backend/main.mo: Actor storing wishes in a List with functions to submit a wish and return all wishes.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state by merging persisted and buffered wishes into a new List.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the wishes admin page update to its source file and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, pages, and configs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes with global theming.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining the root element and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component implementing simple routing between the gift experience and the wishes admin page.
frontend/src/appDomain.ts: Defines the app domain constant and a validation function enforcing length and character rules.
frontend/src/components/CaringMessages.t: Renders a message card with three illustrated SVG icons in a centered layout.
Canvas-based fireworks animation that generates particle bursts with reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer displaying a signature line with name, heart, and date.
frontend/src/components/GiftBox.tsx: Interactive 3D gift box that reveals a wish panel and triggers fireworks when a wish is sent.
frontend/src/components/HeartsRain.tsx: Canvas animation rendering falling hearts with drifting movement and reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/components/WishPanel.tsx: UI panel for submitting a wish with validation, async mutation, and success/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity restoration, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalStorage.ts: Custom hook syncing state with localStorage using JSON serialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for submitting wishes and fetching all wishes via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles with pastel theme, dark mode variants, and custom UI effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/WishesPage.tsx: Admin page displaying all submitted wishes with refresh, loading, and error handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, radius, fonts, and plugins.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s versioned state, architectural notes, backend/Frontend requirements for wish submission and admin viewing, and lists known issues and existing feature specs.
